mLocKeys.keySummary: Increases Wukong's armor and magic resistance for each nearby enemy champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Wukong's gains <scaleArmor>@BonusArmorPerEnemyChamp@ armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>@BonusArmorPerEnemyChamp@ magic resistance</scaleMR> for each nearby enemy champion.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Wukong dashes toward a target enemy and sends out images to attack up to 2 additional enemies near his target, dealing physical damage to each enemy struck.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Wukong dashes toward a target enemy and sends out images to attack up to 2 additional enemies near his target, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to each enemy struck. Upon hitting his target, Wukong gains <attackSpeed>@AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.</mainText>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Crushing Blow</titleLeft><mainText>Wukong's next attack will deal bonus damage, gain range, and reduce the armor of his target.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Wukong's next attack gains extra range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the enemy's Armor.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Wukong's next Attack has @BonusAttackRange@ bonus Attack Range, deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and reduces the enemy's <scaleArmor>Armor by @ArmorShredPercent*-100@%</scaleArmor> for @ShredDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Cyclone</titleLeft><mainText>Wukong is gaining movement speed over time. While spinning, nearby enemies will take damage and be knocked up.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Wukong's staff grows outward and he spins it around, dealing damage and knocking up enemies. Wukong gains movement speed over the duration of the spell.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Wukong's staff grows outward and he spins it around, dealing <physicalDamage>@DamagePerSecondTotal@ physical damage</physicalDamage> per second and <status>Knocking Up</status> enemies he encounters. Wukong gains <speed>Move Speed</speed> over the duration of the spell. Lasts @SpinDuration@ seconds. <recast>Recast:</recast> Cancels the ultimate early.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Wukong becomes invisible for 1.5 seconds. An uncontrollable decoy is left behind that will deal magic damage to enemies near it after 1.5 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Wukong becomes <keywordStealth>Invisible</keywordStealth> for @StealthDuration@ seconds. An uncontrollable decoy is left behind that will deal <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to enemies near it after @CloneDuration@ seconds.</mainText>
